Happy Birthday
Jun 2026 • Solo
I had a beautiful evening at Lee Comptoir. From the moment I arrived, the staff were warm, polite, and genuinely friendly, and the service throughout the night was excellent.

Each dish was delicious and exquisitely presented—truly like edible works of art. Every course felt thoughtfully crafted and balanced, making the whole dining experience memorable from start to finish.

What really made the night extra special was how celebrated I felt. The team went above and beyond by presenting a plate of petit fours with my name and “Happy Birthday” written in chocolate. They also took a photo of me during the evening and later gave it to me in a birthday card as I left. That’s so thoughtful and something I will genuinely treasure forever.

The wine selection was excellent, and starting the evening with champagne and oysters was a perfect touch.

A truly elegant and memorable dining experience—I would absolutely return to try the French cheese next time !

An Outstanding Fine-Dining Experience at Le Comptoir
Feb 2026 • Solo
Me and my girlfriend visited this establishment on the 5:th of february 2026 for the last dinner of our Danang trip. 

We found the restaurant via the MICHELIN Guide, and after our visit we absolutely understand why Le Comptoir was mentioned there.

The restaurant's somewhat hidden location gives it an intimate feel and interior as well as exterior, was friendly, inviting and beautiful.

We were a little bit early but that was not an issue at all, it just took a minute or so before we were escorted to our table.

We went with the "Le Grand Menu" with the Black Angus Tenderloin. Also with wine pairing for the food as well as additional wine pairing for the cheese board that was not included in the original wine pairing.

The service was excellent, and each course was presented with the level of care expected at a restaurant of this caliber.

It was also refreshing to see that the head-chef (Ben / Benjamin) took the time to come out to the dining room and make sure guests were enjoying their meals. We enjoyed the conversations with him very much.

Every dish was exquisite and we have really no complaints at all.

From our perspective, given the prices we are used to at fine-dining restaurants, a visit to Le Comptoir offers outstanding value.
